issues.legal_issue: A widow’s limited interest in property given to her in lieu of maintenance is enlarged into an absolute estate when she possessed the property as the relevant succession law took effect.
material_facts: The widow had a pre-existing right to maintenance from the joint family.
A family member placed her in possession of the suit property in lieu of maintenance, and the maintenance arrangement gave her a life interest.
She remained in possession of the property when the Hindu Succession Act, 1956 came into force.

The trial court found that the maintenance arrangement recognized her maintenance right and that her will was valid; the High Court reversed on the ground that Section 14(2), rather than Section 14(1), applied.
issues.conclusion: The limited interest was enlarged under Section 14(1) into an absolute estate; Section 14(2) did not prevent enlargement. The appeal was allowed, the High Court’s judgment was set aside, and the trial court’s judgment and decree were restored.
issues.legal_principle: The Court held that the issue was fully covered by V. Tulasamma v. Sesha Reddy and followed that decision. Applying Sections 14(1) and 14(2) of the Hindu Succession Act, 1956, it treated a limited interest given in recognition of a pre-existing right to maintenance as one that is enlarged under Section 14(1), rather than excluded from enlargement by Section 14(2).

rule.if: property_recovery_appeal and widow_had_preexisting_maintenance_right and property_given_in_recognition_of_maintenance_right and widow_received_limited_interest and widow_possessed_property_when_succession_law_took_effect

predicates.property_recovery_appeal: The proceeding was an appeal arising from a suit seeking recovery of possession of property.
predicates.widow_had_preexisting_maintenance_right: A widow had a right to maintenance from the family whose property was at issue.
predicates.property_given_in_recognition_of_mainten: The family placed the property in the widow’s possession in recognition of her maintenance right.
predicates.widow_received_limited_interest: The arrangement gave the widow a limited interest in the property.
predicates.widow_possessed_property_when_succession: The widow possessed the property when the relevant succession law took effect.

issues.definition: When a property-recovery appeal involves a widow who possessed property under a limited interest granted in recognition of her pre-existing maintenance right and who remained in possession when the relevant succession law took effect, that limited interest is treated as enlarged into absolute ownership.
